title: Crestline Companion Ticket Taxes and Fees: Tax Note
content:
**Clause.** Under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, the taxes and fees of a booking are the ticket tax of 7.5 percent on its most recent companion fare charge, rounded half up to the cent, plus the flight fees of 23.20 USD.

## Terms

- **Most recent companion fare charge** — the charge entry of component companion fare with the latest entry date in the trip and charge history of the certificate or pass.
- **Ticket tax** — 7.5 percent of that companion fare charge, rounded half up to the cent.
- **Flight fees** — a flat 23.20 USD per booking.
- **Gross taxes and fees** — the ticket tax plus the flight fees.
- **Taxes and fees charged** — the gross taxes and fees less the credits on the taxes and fees, subtracted together, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical companion fare charges)

| Most recent companion fare charge | Ticket tax | Plus flight fees | Taxes and fees |
|---|---|---|---|
| 119.00 USD | 8.925, rounded to 8.93 | 23.20 | 32.13 USD |
| 249.00 USD | 18.675, rounded to 18.68 | 23.20 | 41.88 USD |
| 0.00 USD | 0.00 | 23.20 | 23.20 USD |

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
